title: Invariant 13: PostgreSQL WAL, replication, base backup, PITR, restore drills, and reconstruction receipts protect every s...
goal: Prove operational invariant 13 holds against the live system. Shipped evidence only: a design document, a proposed ADR, or an intent to build never satisfies this probe.
command_template: PSQL="$(command -v psql || echo "$(dirname "$(readlink -f /proc/$(head -1 /home/flexnetos/meta/var/lib/postgresql/17/postmaster.pid 2>/dev/null)/exe 2>/dev/null)")/psql")"; test -x "$PSQL" && "$PSQL" 'postgresql:///lifeos?host=/home/flexnetos/meta/var/run/postgresql' -tAc 'show wal_level' | grep -qE 'replica|logical'
verification_command: PSQL="$(command -v psql || echo "$(dirname "$(readlink -f /proc/$(head -1 /home/flexnetos/meta/var/lib/postgresql/17/postmaster.pid 2>/dev/null)/exe 2>/dev/null)")/psql")"; test -x "$PSQL" && "$PSQL" 'postgresql:///lifeos?host=/home/flexnetos/meta/var/run/postgresql' -tAc 'select pg_is_in_recovery()' | grep -qE 'f|t'
completion_gate: probe exits 0 against the live system; a non-zero exit is a real invariant violation and must not be recorded as pending or proposed
rollback_plan: Read-only probe; nothing to roll back.
